required_target_inputs.name: model_loader
required_target_inputs.description: Local Python loader that instantiates the frozen model without network access.

required_target_inputs.name: tokenizer_or_input_encoder
required_target_inputs.description: Exact encoder used by the existing external validation campaign.

required_target_inputs.name: context_generator
required_target_inputs.description: Frozen prompt or episode generator with stable context identifiers.

required_target_inputs.name: memory_intervention_hook
required_target_inputs.description: Exact hook used to set the recurrent-memory mechanism under matched interventions.

required_target_inputs.name: quotient_discovery
required_target_inputs.description: Discovery procedure or frozen map from physical memory variables to causal minimal macro-roles.

arrays.x: int8 matrix [trials, macro_roles], binary balanced source interventions
arrays.y: int8 matrix [trials, macro_roles], binary next-cycle macro responses
arrays.split: int8 vector [trials], values 0,1,2,3 for the four independent streams
